notes.title: YouTube Playthroughs and Solutions
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Thank you all very much for playing the game. I really enjoy hearing your thoughts and suggestions. I have kept a list of possible improvements that will one day become reality, so please do not hesitate to continue voicing your thoughts!

This summer I have been busy recording a developer playthrough of the game, providing both solutions to all the puzzles and commentary at the same time. Should you find yourself stuck at the game, these can be used as a quick way to access the solution.
All these videos can be [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLFBvo5mKC3u1TnBnrIyLHFAiMXOFGn6l4]found here.[/url]
I hope you will find these videos helpful.

Do you want a more classic YouTube experience, or compare your experiences with those of someone who also plays the game for the first time? The YouTuber Nock has a(n almost) complete Let'sPlay of the game available on his channel!
You can find all the [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL7WWbt6zf0xxM4Ax0b1QbOt2n22Y5-FtW]videos here.[/url]
Huge thanks to Nock for making these fantastic videos!

That is all for now. I don't know yet when the next update for the game rolls around, but I will let you know once it happens. Lastly, the base price for the game will slightly drop soon to honour its first year of being released on steam. How a year can fly by...

Kind regards,
Mike Daas

notes.title: Update for Windows and Linux
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Thanks a lot to all of you for playing Sokoban: The RPG over the past six months - I really enjoyed hearing your feedback!
This resulted in this long overdue update - the reason for this is technical, but I tested it and asked on fora, so I think in the end my worries were void and there should be no issue.
The updates for Mac and VX version of the game will arrive sometime soon, but again due to technical reasons I cannot yet update those versions.
If there's any issues, please do not hesitate to let me know.
I hope you continue to enjoy playing the game.

Kind regards,
Mike

Changes include:
- Displays puzzle number upon entering the map for reference purposes
- Minor typos fixed in dialogues
- 12 new puzzles have been added to be solved after all regular puzzles in the game, which can be accessed from the living room
- Some minor changes in some puzzles
- Other minor bugs reported have been fixed

notes.title: Sokoban: The RPG out now!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

This is a pretty exciting moment - finally Sokoban: The RPG has been released on steam! I thank you all in advance from the bottom of my heart for showing interest in the game - I hope you will enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed making it.

Should you find any errors, ranging from small typos to major bugs, please do not hesitate to post about it on the community forum, or email directly to sokobansteam@gmail.com and I will look at it as soon as possible.
Same goes for any other kinds of comments or recommendations - I'd love to hear from you!

In conclusion, I hope you will have a great time playing this game :)

Yours sincerely,
Mike Daas
